procedures: Primary PTCA with drug-eluting stent to LAD
record.clinical_notes: Presented with acute onset central chest pain, diaphoresis, 2 hrs duration. ECG: STEMI anterior wall. Trop I markedly elevated. Emergency CAG done - 95% proximal LAD occlusion. Primary PTCA + DES to LAD, TIMI III flow achieved post-procedure. Post-PCI course uneventful, no arrhythmia. 2D-Echo: EF 45%, mild hypokinesia anterior wall. DAPT + statin + beta-blocker started. Ambulated D2, discharged stable D4 with cardiac rehab and lifestyle advice.
